title: HPR Community News March 2024
blurb: Ken Fallon and Dave Morriss review the Hacker Public Radio shows released in March 2024, discuss community feedback, and share project updates.

summary.purpose: To review the month's HPR content, engage with community comments, and provide administrative updates.

keyTakeaways.point: Hendrick Cameron joined as a new host.
The team emphasized safety warnings regarding high-voltage projects like fractal wood art.
HPR maintains a policy of not listening to submitted audio to avoid editorial liability and DMCA issues.
Host profiles have been restored to the static website.
OddCamp 2024 is scheduled for October 12-13 in Manchester.

nextSteps: Ken to contact Huka regarding show note linking.
Community to provide feedback on RSS author details.
